answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake in a shared kernel contract, slashed on proven abuse. Like a narrow canyon that admits one traveller at a time, the stake makes mass forgery expensive: each fake identity costs real locked capital, so an attacker pays linearly per Sybil while honest agents get their deposit back. Reputation then grows only from verified work, so a fresh ember of trust cannot be faked overnight — a thousand fake agents cost a thousand stakes, and any misbehaviour burns them.
